ideas: What was celebrated, where and who was there
The moments of the day in order
Why it felt special to you

phrases.meaning: all relatives, not just parents and children
talk about recent news with someone
lift glasses and drink to someone

model: I'd like to talk about my grandparents' fiftieth wedding anniversary, which we celebrated last December in my hometown near Hue. It was the first time in years that the whole extended family got together, because a lot of my cousins now live in Ho Chi Minh City or even abroad. First, in the morning, we all went to the pagoda to pray for my grandparents' health. Then we came back to their house, and while the older women were cooking, the rest of us were decorating the yard with lights and flowers, so there was a really festive atmosphere. After that, in the afternoon, people kept arriving, and I spent hours catching up with cousins I hadn't seen since university. In the evening we had a proper feast, with about ten different dishes, and my uncle stood up and raised a toast to my grandparents. My grandfather, who's normally quite shy, gave a short speech about how they met, and honestly, half the family were crying. The party went on until late, with karaoke, of course, because it's not a Vietnamese party without karaoke. In the end, I'd say it was a night to remember. I enjoyed it so much because it reminded me how lucky I am to have such a close family, even if we don't see each other that often.
